request.amount_ada: No direct treasury withdrawal; proposed Net Change Limit is 500,000,000 ada.
request.deadline: Period ends at the close of Epoch 713, on or about July 3, 2027.
deliverables: Set a fixed cap of 500,000,000 ada on total Treasury Withdrawals debited during Epochs 613-713.
Apply the limit from the start of Epoch 613 on February 13, 2026 through the close of Epoch 713 on or about July 3, 2027.
Count all Treasury Withdrawals already debited during the period toward the limit.
Exclude Treasury inflows from increasing or counting against the limit.
Record DRep agreement if Yes votes exceed 50% of active voting stake.
request.what: Info action to record DRep agreement to a new Net Change Limit for the Cardano Treasury for Epochs 613-713.

claims.claim: The proposal sets a new Net Change Limit of 500,000,000 ada, equal to 500,000,000,000,000 lovelace, for Cardano Treasury withdrawals during Epochs 613-713.
The period begins at the start of Epoch 613 on February 13, 2026 and ends at the close of Epoch 713, on or about July 3, 2027.
The Net Change Limit caps only lovelace removed from the Treasury through enacted Treasury Withdrawals recorded on the Cardano ledger.
Treasury inflows, including reserve and protocol allocations, transaction-fee allocations, refunds, and returned Treasury-funded amounts, are not counted and do not increase the limit.
Treasury Withdrawals already debited during the period count toward the 500,000,000 ada cumulative limit.
The action has no direct on-chain effect and does not authorize any Treasury Withdrawal.
The proposer asserts that the existing 350,000,000 ada Net Change Limit has been useful but is becoming constrained before mid-2027.
The proposer asserts that raising the limit preserves DReps' ability to consider credible Treasury Withdrawals on their merits while retaining a fixed fiscal guardrail.
The proposal states that agreement occurs when Yes votes exceed 50% of active voting stake under TREASURY-01a.
The proposal claims it complies with the enacted Cardano Constitution v2.4 and Appendix I Guardrails and provides an IPFS reference for that constitution.

summary: The document proposes an Info action establishing a 500,000,000 ada Treasury Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713, with ledger-debited withdrawals counted cumulatively and no direct withdrawal authorization.
